purpose: Fresh confirmation aligned with mean score, with bounded composition stress; do not reinterpret the earlier strict confirmation as passed.
primary_estimand: equally weighted mean of the 22 declared family-specific paired score gains
resampling: 10000 paired bootstrap samples within each fixed family; keep family weights fixed, unlike a bootstrap that resamples the family list
composition_stress: minimize gain over family weights summing to1, each between0.5/K and2/K; this is an explicit sensitivity assumption, not knowledge of official family weights
statistical_gate: 2.5th bootstrap percentile of composition-stressed gain must be positive for an arm; two arms each use a one-sided97.5% bound (Bonferroni intention), bootstrap coverage remains approximate
shift_gate: each of the three separately reported shift-group mean gains nonnegative; this is an empirical check, not proof of population noninferiority
hard_gates: same seeds/baselines and frozen policy hash
real CaseVO/LLM validation before packaging an enabled candidate
selection_rule: choose highest standard mean gain among arms passing all gates; report both arms and all losses, including family-specific negative means
legacy_gate: still report each-family-mean-nonnegative status; it does not replace this newly preregistered mean-score criterion
why_change: The competition objective is a mean, not simultaneous nonnegative point estimates in every hand-selected graph family. Preserve a strict action-safety gate and test composition sensitivity on fresh data instead of changing the verdict of the old cohort.
